header.running_head: Refraining from Killing Muslims and the Abomination of Fighting for Land

Busr did as commanded and finding Hadhrat Waa'il (RA) still alive, he brought him to Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA). Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) issued instructions that Hadhrat Waa'il (RA) be given royal welcome and after permitting him to his court, allowed him to sit on his throne. Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) then asked, "Is this throne of mine not better than your camel?" Hadhrat Waa'il (RA) replied, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! I was just newly out of ignorance and kufr at the time and that was the way we lived during the Period of Ignorance. Allaah then brought Islaam to us and Islaam has concealed all that I did."
Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) asked further, "Then what prevented you from assisting me when Uthmaan (RA) trusted you so much and even made you his son-in-law?" Hadhrat Waa'il (RA) replied, "Because you fought a man who was closer to Uthmaan (RA) than yourself. Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) remarked, "How can he be closer to Uthmaan (RA) than me when I am more closely related to Uthmaan (RA)?" Hadhrat Waa'il (RA) replied, "Rasulullaah ﷺ forged a bond of brotherhood between Uthmaan (RA) and Ali (RA) and the bond of brotherhood is stronger than the bond of being a cousin (as you are). Furthermore, I did not want to fight any of the Muhaajireen." Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) asked, "Are we not Muhaajireen as well?" Hadhrat Waa'il (RA) replied, "Did we not stay away from both groups? Another strong reason is that I was once with Rasulullaah ﷺ with a large group when he looked towards the east. He then looked back saying, 'Tribulations shall come to you like the many portions of a dark night. They will be extremely difficult and unpleasant and will appear very fast.' I was the only one who asked, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! What will these tribulations be?' He replied, 'O Waa'il! When two swords cross in Islaam, stay away from either one.'"
Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) then said, "Have you now become a Shi'ee (staunch supporter of Hadhrat Ali (RA))?" "No," replied Hadhrat Waa'il (RA), "I have only become a well-wisher of the Ummah." Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) said, "Had I heard this before, I would have never sent for you." Hadhrat Waa'il (RA) then informed Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA), "Did you not see what Muhammad bin Maslama (RA) did when Uthmaan (RA) was martyred? He took his sword to a rock and hit it until it broke." Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) remarked, "They (the Ansaar) are after all people who have to be tolerated." Hadhrat Waa'il (RA) responded by saying, "Then what will you do about the statement of Rasulullaah ﷺ 'Whoever loves the Ansaar loves them because of his love for me and whoever hates the Ansaar hates them because of his hatred for me.'"
